title: REPORT on the implementation of Europe’s Beating Cancer Plan
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘and to present a revised EU alcohol strategy, including a European zero alcohol consumption strategy for minors, accompanied, where appropriate, by legislative proposals in line with Article 168 TFEU and’
part_context: Calls on the Commission and the Member States to promote measures to reduce and prevent alcohol-related harm, <del>and to present a revised EU alcohol strategy, including a European zero alcohol consumption strategy for minors, accompanied, where appropriate, by legislative proposals in line with Article 168 TFEU and</del> respecting the principle of subsidiarity; urges the Member States to devise awareness-raising initiatives geared especially towards minors with a view to providing clear information about alcohol-related harm, so as to promote informed choices and help people better understand the effects of harmful alcohol consumption, particularly at levels exceeding scientifically established health recommendations, on their health;
